title: Skala option registry
description: The single source of truth for every style option Skala knows about. docs/plan/03-configuration-model.md § "The option registry".

valueAliases.description: ReSharper's alternative spellings for a value, e.g. true -> always.

key.description: The canonical .editorconfig spelling, verbatim. The most specific one ReSharper documents.

aliases.description: Every other spelling ReSharper accepts for this one option. An alias that reaches two options is SK9004.

type.description: bool | int | string | enum:<Name>, where <Name> is a key of `enums`.

default.description: ReSharper's default for this option, in its .editorconfig spelling. Read together with defaultSource: it is only trustworthy when defaultSource is resharper-docs.

defaultSource.description: Where `default` came from. resharper-docs: verified against JetBrains' published property tables. oracle-probe: derived by running jb cleanupcode under a configuration carrying nothing but root = true and comparing against the fixture that exercises the option — a strong signal rather than proof, because options interact. template: the value the Rider export holds, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two. unknown: no basis beyond the export. `skala config distill` may only drop a key when this is resharper-docs or oracle-probe.

tier.description: docs/plan/03 § "Four tiers". A: implemented and pinned by an oracle fixture. B: approximated, with a documented divergence. C: accepted and deliberately ignored. D: known but not implemented.

templateLine.description: The line in editor_config_template this entry was seeded from. Provenance only.

severitySuffix.description: True for Microsoft style keys written as value:severity.

expands.description: For one of ReSharper's generalized properties, the options it sets at once.
